remarks:
Sunset Bay’s only duplex is for sale! Rare bay-corner 2-unit with oversized boat-ready garage, steps to marina, boat launch, beachfront restaurants and sandy beach. Perfect as a year-round retreat, summer compound or income property in one of Chautauqua County’s most popular vacation neighborhoods!

Each side is turn key offering 3 furnished bedrooms, spacious living room and large eat-in kitchen. Side A: 1.5 baths. Side B: first-floor bedroom plus 2 full baths. Both units share a large two-level covered back deck that spans the width of the building- ideal for outdoor entertaining or rental guest relaxation. Coin-op washer/dryer, separate electric boxes, hot water tanks and boilers are conveniently located in the common entry. Driveway/off-street parking for each unit and a partially fenced corner lot add privacy and convenience.

Exceptional storage space: oversized detached garage approx. 23' x 33' with ~12' clearance from floor to rafters—room for your boat, cars and beach gear. Recent updates include a metal roof on both house and garage and nearly all replacement windows. Sellers can provide carefully screened renter contact information to buyer to help transition rental income; summer weekly rental potential is strong in this market (potential to make 3,000+ per week; buyer to verify).

Short walk to marina, state marine park, waterfront dining and all the summer activities that make Sunset Bay a seasonal hotspot. Don’t miss this one-of-a-kind opportunity to own the only duplex in Sunset Bay. Ideal for those who want personal waterfront enjoyment plus proven rental demand!
